seed_input: imvision.se LED display / digital signage (EN root + /sv/ Swedish twin)
architecture_note: IM Vision has three genuinely separate commercial motions (permanent sales/install, event rental, service/ops) that returned near-zero SERP overlap with each other in sampling. Rather than force a single mega-pillar (which the base schema assumes), this plan defines THREE parallel hub-and-spoke clusters, one per existing commercial hub page (/sales/, /rental/, /service/). Each independently satisfies the 2-5 clusters x 2-4 posts constraint. /about/, /contact/, and / (home) are excluded as navigational/utility. /projects/ is treated as a cross-cutting proof layer (18 existing case studies), not a keyword-targeted spoke -- individual case studies are used as internal-link evidence, not rewritten.
data_source_disclosure: SERP data collected via WebSearch (not DataForSEO), so scores below are ESTIMATES calibrated from observed domain overlap across ~24 representative queries (documented per pair), not exhaustive top-10 URL-set intersections. No search-volume numbers are stated anywhere in this file; all volume/impact language is qualitative and labelled 'estimate' in the markdown summary. GSC 28-day actuals (to 2026-07-27) are the only hard numbers used.

gsc_baseline_28d_to_2026-07-27.signal: English demand vocabulary clusters on 'digital signage', not 'LED display' -- the vocabulary the site currently uses. 'digital signage installation' and 'digital display solutions' already rank pos 2.0 on near-zero impressions, meaning the site is one content/vocabulary fix away from real traffic on terms it can already win.

priority_build_order.action: Retarget primary keyword/H1/meta on existing /sales/, /service/, /support/ pages to 'digital signage' vocabulary (no new URLs)

priority_build_order.rationale: Vocabulary-bridge post first (it links everywhere), then the two verticals with the deepest existing proof (4 mall case studies, 3 façade/roadside case studies), then retail.
Buyer-education content for the long B2B sales cycle -- cost guide is highest-value gap (currently zero capture).
Rental has the clearest existing GSC foothold (pos 11.0) of any non-brand query -- consolidate it, then expand outward. Buy-vs-rent bridge built first to start cross-linking early.

Retention/upsell value rather than new-customer acquisition -- lowest priority for a lead-generation-focused first pass, but reuses an existing URL (/support/) and unlocks the Ocean Outdoor proof story.
